Product Description  Origin: UE  Fondant S20 is a pasty confectionery consisting of sugar and glucose syrup (ratio 100 to 20). The microfine sugar crystals give the product its creamy consistency and the tender glaze.  Specification  Legal Compliance  Fondant S20 complies with the applicable provisions of the German and European Food Law, in par-  ticular the German “Lebensmittel - , und Futtermittelgesetzbuch (LFGB)“ and the European   Regulation  (EC) No 178/2002 (“General Food Law”) and Regulation (EC) No 852/2004. Its packaging complies  with Regulation (EC) No 1935/2004 as well as specific provisions set in Regulation (EC) No 10/2011.
